questions.text: I noticed he slipped out for a couple of hours 3 days ago and came back acting strange. Sorry to start here, but could you please check his schedule and find out the name of the person he went to meet? It wasn't me.
questions.hint: Check his Calendar around that time(3 days ago).

questions.text: I knew it... something's off. He has never once mentioned that name in front of me. Do you know what app the two of them have been talking on?
questions.hint: Check the messaging app for a conversation between the two of them.

questions.text: Alright, this is getting out of control. He deleted the chat — what did Rue send him that he's trying to hide?
questions.hint: Read the WhatsApp thread with Rue: what did she send over, and what did Ivo do with it?

questions.text: That's surprising... she makes jewelry. The sneaking around, the wiped chats, all of it... Why would he be ordering a ring from a jeweler? What is he planning to do?
questions.hint: You've already got every clue you need — think it through. Why would Ivo be secretly buying a ring from a jeweler?

questions.text: Oh my god. I've spent a whole month grieving over something that was never even happening. Sorry — Rue only sold it to him. The ring he picked, which brand is it?
questions.hint: Dig into his bank transactions for the ring he bought, then match it against the rings in the jeweler's selection email.

questions.text: Tiffany & Co. He really did that, for me. This is a terrible thing to ask and I want to know anyway — what colour did he pick?
questions.hint: Pull up the purchase details on RevoBank.

questions.text: Am I really crying over a ring right now :( What did he have engraved inside it?
questions.hint: See if there's an email where he arranges the ring's engraving.

onboarding.text: Hi… A friend said you're the person to come to for this kind of thing. I need you.
onboarding.label: Nora

onboarding.text:
Four years with Ivo, the last two of them under the same roof.
Nothing was ever hidden between us. I have never had to wonder where he was. Not once, not ever That openness was the whole foundation.
onboarding.label: Nora & Ivo

onboarding.text:
But these past few weeks his phone never leaves his hand. 
He turns it face-down when I walk past, he takes his calls outside. 
Last week I caught him deleting messages. Why would he do that?
onboarding.label: Ivo

onboarding.text: Yesterday morning, while he was in the shower, I took his phone and copied everything onto my Mac before he came out. So — you have all of it now. Tell me what he's hiding.
onboarding.label: Nora

msgs.text: Mind if I grab your drill on Saturday?
Sure, it's in the garage. I'll bring it over.
Cheers son. Got shelves to put up.
No problem, I'll drop it over late afternoon.
You catch the game last night?
Nah I missed it, was it any good?
3-1! They were excellent.
Brilliant. I'll find the highlights tonight.
You get the car in for a service yet?
Yeah, took it in last week.
Good. That's not something to let slide.
All taken care of dad, promise.
Barbecue at ours on Sunday. Can you make it?
Oh nice! Yeah count me in.
Good. Bring that salad of yours.
Will do! Sunday then.
Feel like getting out on the golf course next week?
Sure, works for me. What day were you thinking?
Wednesday afternoon if that's open for you.
Is that the course out by the river?
That's the one. Twilight rate after four.
Even better.
Bring the clubs I gave you, not the rentals.
Let me check my week and I'll confirm.
You read that piece on the new reform?
Not yet, worth a look?
It is, actually. I'll forward it to you.
babe can you swing by Mariano's on your way back?
yeah of course, what do we need?
milk, eggs, and bread please
on it 👍
when are you getting home tonight?
usually around 7, what's up?
was thinking we could do sushi 🍣
yes! love that
any plans for the weekend?
maybe a walk if the weather holds up?
love it! and a movie later?
sounds good 😊
what should we put on tonight?
there's a new crime show out
oh yeah? which one?
The Night Agent, something like that
okay let's give it a shot! 😊
running on empty today 😴
rough night?
yeah, kept waking up
aw babe... maybe nap this afternoon?
good call ❤️
I really need a getaway
where would you want to go?
Maui! it's been forever
for real... we should plan it
maybe sometime in April?
possibly! let me look at what's still free
yesss! counting down already 💕
fancy a restaurant Saturday night?
totally! got somewhere in mind?
the Thai place everyone keeps raving about
yes! Thai is always a win
putting us down for 8 then 🥰
you grab your keys?
ugh no, thank you!
I know you way too well 😂
look at the neighbor's cat, so cute
haha he looks kinda goofy in that pic
noo he's precious 🐱
whatever you say my love
heading to the gym tonight, wanna come?
sorry, already got plans with Tam
all good! have a good one
thanks babe 💕
got my nails booked in at the salon
oh nice! for when?
September 18, wanna look my best for our weekend
smart 😊
so hyped we're doing Maui end of April!!
same! we've earned it
did you lock in the hotel?
yep all set! keeping the name a surprise 😉
ooh you know I love a surprise 😍
want some coffee?
yes please!
sugar?
two, same as always
coming right up 😘
Marie's asked us over for dinner on Friday
oh fun! who else is going?
I think Paul and Simone are coming
sounds great, I'm in
zero energy to cook tonight
order in on Uber Eats?
yesss 🙌
Indian or Chinese, what are we thinking?
Indian, I need tikka masala
what's the plan for Saturday?
got a thing in the afternoon
okay! couch and TV that night then?
perfect 💕
can we hit Ikea this weekend?
again? 😅
the living room still needs a new lamp
fine but not three hours this time
promise! meatballs after though, non negotiable
wake up sleepyhead
five more minutes...
nope, you're gonna be late
fine fine, I'm up
just a couple weeks till Maui!! 😍
I know! it's gonna be so good
four years together already... wild right?
best four years of my life 💕
awww love you ❤️
love you too
which lipstick do you like better?
um... red?
but which red 😂
the one on the left I think
okay thanks babe
pizza tonight?
never say no to pizza
pepperoni or four cheese?
pepperoni for me
on it, ordering now 😊
love you babe ❤️
love you too gorgeous
can't wait to be home with you
me too 💕
what are you feeling for dinner?
whatever sounds good to you my love
carbonara?
yes! perfect
You pick up the new Call of Duty?
Yeah got it yesterday.
Any good?
Yeah pretty solid, multiplayer's a blast.
Right, I'll pick it up as well then.
Wes is throwing something on Friday, you in?
Definitely. Who else is going?
Same crew as always.
Nice, I'll bring the beers.
Any chance I can borrow Elden Ring?
Yeah of course, when do you want it?
Tomorrow work?
Great, I'm around from the afternoon.
FIFA tonight?
Go on then. You know how this ends for you.
Big words 😂
10 at yours?
Works for me.
Tonight, McDonald's run?
Go on then.
Want me to swing by for you at 9?
Cool, sounds good.
Any chance you've got a decent CV template?
Mine's not bad, I'll send it over.
You looking for a new job?
Yeah, I've had enough of this place.
Damn, good luck man.
Got an interview next week.
Oh good one! Who with?
A tech startup.
That sounds like a proper fit.
Yeah, fingers crossed.
Pizza for lunch, you in?
Sorry, already ate.
All good.
Swim Sunday morning?
What time?
10, run a few laps.
Count me in.
Been to that new bar on the square?
Not yet, is it good?
Yeah, laid back and cheap.
Thursday night then?
Deal, Thursday it is!
Ugh, my controller just gave up.
Aw man, was it old?
Two years, brutal stick drift.
Typical. Time for a replacement.
Yeah, I'll have a look on Amazon.
Have you caught the new Marvel one?
Not yet, is it any good?
Eh, not great but watchable.
Fair enough, onto the list it goes.
New controller finally showed up 🎮
About time. Same model?
Nah, went for the pro one this time
Fancy. No excuses when you lose now then
We'll see about that 😂
Office all day today, deadline from hell 😩
Rough, you'll survive 💪
Just got home, completely wiped
Same here, night 😴
Shooting hoops tomorrow afternoon?
Yeah works, 3 at the gym?
Cool, I'll let the others know.

That was proper fun. Same again soon?
Friday night?
Works for me.
Can you spot me 50 bucks till next week?
Yeah no problem.
Legend. You'll have it back Friday.
No rush at all.
You in for soccer Sunday?
Count me in.
Good, midfield is yours.
Noted. Sunday then.
Pint sometime this week?
I'm up for that. Thursday evening?
Works. Usual pub.
See you there 👍
You see that new game dropping tomorrow?
Yeah, going back and forth on buying it.
It's $70 though, which is a lot for day one.
That's exactly what's stopping me.
It'll be half that by Christmas, but I'm not waiting.
I'm buying it, so we can run co-op.
Alright, twist my arm. I'll get it too.
Fancy a game later?
Yeah after dinner, like 9?
Yep, I'll have it loaded.

Hey honey, how are you doing?
All good here mom, how about you?
Fine thanks! Are we seeing you for Sunday lunch?
Try and stop me!
Lovely. I'll cook the one you always ask for 😊
You know that cake you couldn't stop eating?
The chocolate lava cake?
That's the one. Sending it to you now.
Aw thanks mom ❤️
Could you pick up milk before Sunday?
Sure! How many should I get?
Two will do, thank you darling.
No problem.
Put in some tomato plants out back today.
The ones from Nana's cuttings?
Those, plus two I picked up at the garden center.
You always end up with more than you can eat.
Lovely! Put a few aside for me?
Naturally. Give them 2 months and they're yours.
Perfect, nobody grows them like you.
Are you taking your vitamins?
Yes mom, don't worry 😅
I'll always worry about you!
I know, thanks for looking out for me.
Your dad finally fixed the dripping faucet.
About time! That's been on his list for weeks.
I know 😂 but it's done now.
Good news. Sunday then mom.
Have you been to the new Italian yet?
Not yet, where's it at?
Right beside the gym, you can't miss it.
Oh right! Worth it?
So good man, we've gotta go.
Let's do it. Next week?
Ball tomorrow afternoon?
I'm around. What time?
4 at the usual court.
See you there.
Great, the others already know.
Yo, are you around Friday for drinks?
For sure. Yours or mine?
Mine, fridge is stocked.
Perfect, chips are on me.
If you still haven't done Breaking Bad, fix that.
Dude, third time through already 😂
Wow, you're a real diehard.
Nothing else comes close for me.
Agreed. Walter White carries the whole thing.
Gym tonight, you in?
Yeah, does 7 work?
Works. Today is legs.
Ugh, not leg day 😅
Don't be soft man!
Saturday morning, tennis?
You know I'm hopeless at tennis.
No stress, we'll take it easy.
Sure, 10 sound good?
Sorted, I'll grab a court.
Did you see? They've announced a June show.
Who's playing?
Arctic Monkeys, who else!
Oh nice! Should we grab tickets?
Leave it with me, I'll sort it tomorrow.
I landed the job dude!
Massive news! Well done!
Thanks! I start Monday.
So happy for you, we celebrating?
Yeah Friday night, whole crew's invited.
I'm there.
My PS5 just died, this is the worst.
No way. Is it still in warranty?
Sadly not... I'm on to support now.
Good luck man, keep me posted.
Feel like going to the stadium on Sunday?
I'm in. You've got seats?
Yeah, my brother can't make it.
Amazing! Who are the Bears playing?
New Orleans. It'll be a loud one.
Biggest game of the season! Can't wait.
Burger tomorrow lunchtime?
I could eat. Five Guys?
Done, I'll put us down for 12:30.
Great, tomorrow then!
Mountain hike next weekend?
Depends how long it is.
Pretty easy trail, nothing crazy.
Alright, I'm coming.
Great! Early start though.
Can I borrow your car Sunday?
Yeah sure, what for?
A friend is moving and my car won't take it.
Fine, you'll have it Saturday evening.
Thanks man, you're the best!
Saturday is Simone's birthday, by the way.
Oh no I completely forgot! What are we getting her?
Was thinking a nice restaurant, all chip in?
Yeah for sure, good shout.
I'll make the booking and tell you what you owe.
Are you any good at putting Ikea furniture together?
Yeah, why?
Bought a bookshelf and it's beating me.
😂 want a hand?
Yes please, that would save me.
I'll come over on Sunday then.
We're doing poker on Saturday, in?
Yeah! Where at?
At Grant's, he's bought a proper poker table.
Perfect! I'll roll up about 8.
You get the new Xbox?
Nah, holding out for a sale.
Sensible, dude.
Did you grab it?
Yeah, zero regrets, it's sweet.
Are you through season 2 of The Last of Us yet?
Still going, I'm on episode 5.
Okay, I'll keep it spoiler free 😅
Thanks man!
Feel like sushi tonight?
Always.
Usual place at 8 p.m.?
Great, I've been wanting that all week.
Me too, it's been a month since I had Japanese.
Down for a ski trip in March?
I'm in. Whereabouts?
Vail, with Tam and Dez.
Count me in, what dates?
I'll get them to you tomorrow.
Gym in the morning?
What time?
7am, before work.
7's brutal though 😅
It sets you up for the whole day though.
Fine, you've convinced me.
Game at the stadium on Sunday, are you up for it?
Sorry, can't, family lunch.
No worries, next time.
Yeah definitely!
Cinema this week?
Sure! Anything worth seeing?
The new Nolan one just landed.
Oh nice! Wednesday night?
Great, I'll sort the tickets.
You know anyone who works in marketing?
What's up?
Trying to get some pointers for my project.
My sister is in comms, I'll put it to her.
Ah sweet, thanks man!
The guys are going karting Saturday, coming?
Definitely! Who's in?
Us plus Tam, Dez and Wes.
So fun, I love go-karting.
Me too. We're meeting there at 2 p.m.
The baby finally slept through the whole night 🙌
Huge! Tell her uncle Ivo is proud
Don't jinx it, she's already fighting bedtime again 😅
Haha good luck tonight 😂
Have you got into the new season on Netflix?
Not yet! Is it good?
So good! But no spoilers, deal?
Fine, nothing spoiled. I'll start it this weekend.
Come shopping with me on Saturday?
What, again? 😅
Come on, please! I need a second opinion from a guy.
Okay but not four hours this time.
Deal! Best brother 😘
Should we do a dinner, just us siblings?
Love that. Tuesday next week?
Yes! The new Japanese place near me?
Okay works.
Marguerite from college, does that ring a bell?
Sort of, yeah.
She's throwing a party Saturday for her birthday.
Oh that's great for her!
My laptop's lagging so bad, can you take a look?
Sure, I can come round tomorrow and look.
Thank youuu, you're a lifesaver 😇
No problem sis 😂
Have you got through that book I lent you?
Nearly, 50 pages to go.
So? Are you liking it?
Yeah it's really good!
There's my Ivo! Hello darling.
Hi grandma! How are you?
Not bad at all, dear. Are you eating properly?
Yes grandma, don't worry.
I'll always worry about you 😊
Are you coming to visit soon?
Yes grandma, this coming Sunday?
Please do! I'll bake the cake you love.
Lovely. Sunday it is.
I dug up some old photos of you as a little one.
Oh no 😅 please tell me they aren't too embarrassing.
You were the sweetest thing. I'll dig them out for you.
Okay grandma, can't wait to see them.
The roses have come out beautifully this year.
The pink ones by the gate?
Those, and the climbing one has finally taken 😊
About time, that one took years.
Oh really? Send me a photo then?
Of course sweetheart. Better still, come and see them.
I'll come and see you soon, promise.
Shall I pass on my beef stew recipe?
Yes please grandma!
I'll copy it out for you.
Thanks grandma, you're the best ❤️
My knee's doing better, I can walk without any pain now.
That's wonderful grandma, so glad to hear it.
Thank you sweetheart. When will you come by?
Very soon, I promise.
Hi, I can swing by tomorrow afternoon to look at the problem. Does that work for you?
That works! What sort of time?
I can be with you about 3 if that suits.
Perfect, until tomorrow then.
About 10 minutes away.
Great, I'll let you in when you ring.
Sorted. The breaker was the problem. I'll send the quote over by text.
Thanks so much! What do I owe you?
$120 with tax. Bank transfer or check is fine.
Understood, I'll send the transfer this evening.
Much appreciated, enjoy your evening!
Payment is in, thank you. Give me a shout if anything else comes up.
Thank you!
Hey love ❤️
Hey my love 💕
You still asleep? 😅
Yeah still in bed lol
Such a sloth 😂
Saturday privileges!
Haha true.
Come and get brunch with me?
Yes absolutely! Where should we go?
There's that new café down by the Riverwalk.
Lovely! Give me ten minutes to get ready and I'll head over.
Okay babe, meet up in an hour? 😘
See you in a bit, my love ❤️
Thanks for brunch babe, that was so good 🥰
Any time sweetheart! Loved every minute with you.
Me too ❤️
Are we seeing each other tonight?
Yes! You coming to mine or want me at yours?
Happy to come to yours.
Okay perfect 😊
Babe, could you pick up bread on the way back? 🥖
Consider it done, I'll stop in on the way.
Thanks my love ❤️
Which one, baguette or the country loaf?
Baguette, the traditional one please.
Okay 👍
Do you love me? 🥺
Of course sweetheart! Why do you ask?
Just because 😊 felt like asking.
You mean more to me than anything in this world ❤️
I love you too baby 💕
Nothing better has ever happened to me than you.
Careful, you'll set me off 🥹
But it's the truth.
I love you so much ❤️❤️❤️
Love you too my darling 💕
Goodnight baby 😘
Goodnight my love, sweet dreams ❤️
Oh I forgot to mention, my mom wants to have us over for dinner this weekend.
Oh nice! Saturday or Sunday?
Sunday night, I think.
Sunday is fine by me.
Lovely! I'll tell her to expect us 😊
Think she'll make that amazing potato gratin again?
Haha probably, she knows it's your favorite 😂
Now I'm hungry just thinking about it.
Haha you'll have to hold out till Sunday.
Babe, a meeting has landed on me, I'll be back late tonight.
No problem love. What time do you think you'll be finished?
8:30 p.m. ish, I reckon.
Alright. Shall I cook for you?
Oh yes you're the best! 🥰
Yes please babe ❤️
I love you
Love you too 💕
I'm clearing out this whole thread, it's way too risky if she ever picks up my phone
Same, better safe than sorry
Reminder — I'm swinging by to see you tomorrow!
Everything's ready on my side, don't stress 😊
Hey, where'd you go?
Almost there, like two minutes out.
You bolted out of here so fast earlier 😭 I never got to finish telling you something
Sorry sorry, had to duck out before Nora started asking questions 😂
Ha, fair enough 😂 you made it home okay though?
Yeah all good, thanks again for today 😉
Don't worry, I'll keep it low-key and hide the pictures somewhere she won't look haha
Haha okay! But for real, you need to pick one soon.
Did the photos go through on Snap?
Got them, thank you! Already deleted the chat so Nora can't stumble on it.
Want me to send a second set of photos? Better lighting this time.
Yes please 👌
Ivo, hi! Any chance you could send me the notes from yesterday's lecture?
Hey! Which one?
The digital marketing one, I missed it 😅
Ah dang, I wasn't there either lol
Oh no 😭 Wes it is then.
Yeah good idea, he never misses.
Hey, are you working on the group project?
Yeah I got started on my part yesterday.
Good for you! I'm a bit stuck 😓
We could hop on a call to go over it if you want.
Oh you're a lifesaver! Does tomorrow work?
Yeah, around 3?
You're a star, thank you 🙏
No problem.
Yo, have you seen the newest The Last of Us episode?
Not yet! No spoilers, but is it worth it?
Bro. You need to sit down and watch it.
This weekend then, promise.
You still playing FIFA?
Yeah here and there, why?
I got back on it last week, my squad is stacked now.
Of course it is 😂
Ultimate Team is a money pit, I know, I know.
You say that every single year.
Should we get a few games in online sometime?
Yes, count me in.
Great 🎮 I'll message you when I've got a window.
Okay perfect
Are you around to play tonight?
Probably not, Nora is coming round.
Ah okay, no worries man.
Maybe tomorrow?
Yeah we'll see 👌
Ivo! It has been far too long 😊
Odile, hey! It really has. How are you?
Good thanks! I got back from vacation two days ago.
Oh nice, where'd you go?
Portugal! Honestly stunning 😍
Nice! Bet you came back with a thousand photos.
Loads! I'm putting an album up on Insta.
And you, anything new?
Not a lot. Work and Nora, that's about it lol
You two are the cutest ❤️
Thanks 😊
We've got to set up a night with the whole group!
Honestly yes! Let's get a date in soon.
Great, I'll let you know 👌
Yo dude what's the plan this weekend?
Nothing much, why?
I've got two tickets for Saturday's game, want one?
Yes! Which game is it?
the Bears against the Packers, at the stadium.
Absolutely!!! I'm there, no question.
Nice 👌 let's meet at 6 by the west entrance.
Great! Have you asked Beck?
Nah he can't, he's working.
His loss 😅
Yeah lol
Oh by the way, are you shooting photos at the game?
Obviously! The DSLR is coming with me.
Nice, looking forward to those 📸
I'll put an album together for you after the game, don't worry.
Ivo! Fancy a game of soccer on Sunday morning?
Rory! Definitely, where at?
At the field in the park, same as usual.
What time?
10 sharp, we've already got 12 guys.
I'll be there.
Nice one! Bring your cleats.
All packed already 👍
You were unplayable today! And that goal 🔥
Haha thanks bro! That was a good game.
My legs are wrecked today though 😅
Same here, my calves are gone.
Worth it.
Yeah! Same again next Sunday?
Not sure yet, I'll let you know in the week.
Yeah all good.
Hey, you know a good physical therapist?
Yeah, I know a great one over in Logan Square.
Perfect, I'll book in. Thanks.
Hey! Did Marie's birthday invite reach you?
Yeah I saw it pop up! When is it again?
It's the 15th, next Saturday.
Okay got it! You going?
Yeah for sure! Wanna meet there?
Yeah perfect.
Will Nora be there as well?
Probably, I'll double check with her.
Good, it has been ages since I saw her 😊
Any thoughts on what to get Marie?
Not a clue yet... a Best Buy gift card maybe?
Good call! She loves to read.
Should we go in on the gift together?
Yeah, that'll be easier.
Okay, $30 each?
Works for me 👍
Yo, have you had a listen to the new Drake yet?
Not yet, is it good?
Unreal bro. That 21 Savage track especially.
Right, tonight's listening is sorted then.
Tell me what you make of it.
Oh hey, did you get tickets for the March concert?
Got mine yesterday. Category 1.
Nice, me too 🔥
That show is going to be something.
Counting down already.
We should do brunch before the concert.
Good shout! There's a new place over by Humboldt Park.
Oh yeah I know exactly the one you mean.
Should we book it for the weekend of the concert?
Works for me 👍
I'll book it closer to the date.
Nice one.
Yo bro
Hey Dez!
Feels like ages since we last saw each other, no?
Yeah for real, like two months I think.
We really need to hang, bro.
Definitely! When are you around?
I dunno, maybe at Tam's birthday?
Okay sounds good, we'll keep it chill.
Yeah let's just grab a beer somewhere.
Beer it is 🍺
How's it going with Nora anyway?
Really well actually. We're happy.
So happy for you man.
Just make sure I'm on the wedding list 😂
Haha don't worry, you're first on the list.
Haha perfect.
Right, I'm out bro. Catch you at Tam's then.
Okay see you bro.

notes.title: Carbonara, how I make it
notes.body:
🍝 PASTA CARBONARA (for 2)

Ingredients:
- 7 oz pasta (spaghetti)
- 5 oz smoked bacon
- 2 egg yolks
- 1/2 cup grated parmesan
- Black pepper
- Salt

Preparation:
1. Cook pasta al dente
2. Fry bacon without fat
3. Mix yolks + parmesan in a bowl
4. Drain pasta (keep some water)
5. Mix pasta + bacon off heat
6. Add egg-parmesan mixture
7. Stir quickly, add cooking water if needed
8. Pepper generously

Tip: Don't put back on heat after adding eggs!
